place.summary: Times Square functions primarily as a connector in Hong Kong's visitor network. Its strongest observed source market is PH. It receives notable inbound connections from Causeway Bay. Visitors often continue to Hong Kong Disneyland. Its observed experience trails the category average, despite existing visitor demand.
